environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a VPC with a public-facing Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB has a public DNS name and accepts TCP connections from any source IP on port 443. TLS termination occurs at the application level. No rate limiting or request throttling is configured. The service is reachable from the internet with sub-millisecond jitter on the NLB path.
